name: cache-bar
description: Shows prompt cache hit rate and TTL status in Claude Code

ttlMode.title: Cache TTL
ttlMode.description: auto infers 5m or 1h from what the cache does; 5m or 1h fixes it

onExpiring.title: When the cache is about to expire
onExpiring.description: notify: notify only; button: notify and offer an extend button; auto: extend automatically

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Desktop only. compact: the countdown, with details on hover; off: no band, toasts only

warnAtPercent.title: Warn at % left
warnAtPercent.description: The countdown turns orange when this much of the TTL is left

alertAtPercent.title: Alert at % left
alertAtPercent.description: Notify (and offer to extend) when this much of the TTL is left

toast.title: Toast notifications
toast.description: Show a toast when the cache is about to expire

autoExtendMaxPerIdle.title: Auto-extend: max per idle stretch
autoExtendMaxPerIdle.description: How many times to extend automatically while you are away

autoExtendMinContextK.title: Auto-extend: minimum context (k tokens)
autoExtendMinContextK.description: Don't extend a cache smaller than this; rewriting it is cheap

autoExtendGiveUpMin.title: Auto-extend: give up after (minutes idle)
autoExtendGiveUpMin.description: Stop extending once you have been away this long; 0 means no time limit

breakSensitivity.title: Cache break sensitivity
breakSensitivity.description: How readily a drop in hit rate counts as a cache break: low, medium or high
